# Enough Path

> Free FIRE (financial independence, retire early) calculators and guides for readers in the United States. Every figure is in today's dollars and is computed by the same open formulas the calculators use. Educational information only, not financial advice. Edited by Asier Fernández.

Returns typed before inflation are converted with the exact Fisher formula (7% with 3% inflation is 3.88% real). Formulas, default assumptions and the automated tests are listed in the methodology.

## Calculators
- [FIRE calculator](https://enoughpath.com/calculators/fire-calculator/): your FIRE number and the age you reach it for lean, regular and fat FIRE with the same assumptions. Example: $40,000 a year at a 4% withdrawal rate needs $1,000,000.
- [Coast FIRE calculator](https://enoughpath.com/calculators/coast-fire-calculator/): how much you need invested today to reach your FIRE number by retirement with no more saving. Example: $231,377 at 35 grows to $1,000,000 by 65 at 5% a year after inflation.
- [How long will my money last calculator](https://enoughpath.com/calculators/how-long-will-my-money-last/): years a portfolio lasts at a fixed yearly withdrawal in today's dollars, with a test of two bad years at the start. Example: $40,000 a year from $1,000,000 at 3% real lasts 44.1 years.
- [Net worth by age calculator](https://enoughpath.com/calculators/net-worth-by-age/): your percentile among US families your age, from the Federal Reserve's 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances (median for all families: $216,100).

## Guides
- [What is FIRE? Financial independence in numbers](https://enoughpath.com/fire-basics/what-is-fire/): What financial independence means, the five versions and how much each one costs.
- [The 4% rule explained](https://enoughpath.com/fire-basics/4-percent-rule/): Where the 4% rule comes from, how long a portfolio lasts at each rate and what the rule leaves out.
- [How to calculate your FIRE number](https://enoughpath.com/fire-basics/fire-number/): The formula, three worked examples, a table by spending level and how other income lowers it.
- [Lean, regular, fat, coast and barista FIRE compared](https://enoughpath.com/fire-basics/lean-fat-coast-barista-fire/): All five types for the same household: portfolio needed, age reached and what each one asks of you.
- [Coast FIRE: how much you need by age](https://enoughpath.com/fire-by-age/coast-fire/): What coast FIRE means and the amount you need at 25, 30, 35, 40 and 45.
- [Net worth by age in 2025: what the Fed's new survey shows](https://enoughpath.com/fire-by-age/net-worth-by-age-2025/): Median and average net worth by age from the Federal Reserve's 2025 survey, and what changed since 2022.
- [How long will $1 million last in retirement?](https://enoughpath.com/withdrawal-strategies/how-long-will-1-million-last/): Years $1 million lasts by withdrawal and return, for $500,000 and $2 million too, and what two bad years at the start do.
- [How much do you need to retire at 40?](https://enoughpath.com/fire-by-age/retire-at-40/): The portfolio you need by spending level for a 50-year retirement, what it takes to save it and how to bridge to 59½.
- [Can you retire at 50 with $1, $2 or $3 million?](https://enoughpath.com/fire-by-age/retire-at-50-with-1-2-3-million/): What $1M, $2M and $3M pay each year from 50, how long each lasts at each spending level and what Social Security adds.
